_README: Hand-verified corrections that override what is inferred from vlr.gg.
vlr's role filter reports a player's MOST-PLAYED agent role. That is a poor
signal for two things the game cares about:
1. who calls (IGL) — vlr does not publish this at all, so the builder
otherwise guesses 'highest igl attribute among support roles'
2. who is genuinely flex — the builder otherwise picks whichever duplicate
is lower rated, which is arbitrary and demonstrably wrong
Anything listed here is real information entered by hand and wins over the
inference. Anything NOT listed keeps the inferred value. Nothing in this file
is invented — leave a team out rather than guess at it.
The systematic fix is to scrape each player's per-role round distribution
from vlr (role=duelist|initiator|controller|sentinel) and take flex from
actual agent-pool breadth. Until that is available, correct teams here.
